Single-file .glb only, exported with an: Single-file .glb only, exported with an animation clip baked in (e.g. an "open" Action in Blender). .gltf (multi-file) isn't supported.
Must match the exact name of the baked a: Must match the exact name of the baked animation clip in the .glb file — played forward on click, backward on the next click.
A fallback image is required \u2014 it's: A fallback image is required — it's shown while the model loads and if WebGL isn't supported.
Describes the interaction for screen rea: Describes the interaction for screen reader users, e.g. "Interactive 3D laptop model — click to open or close."
A default label will be used, but a spec: A default label will be used, but a specific one is recommended.
Any CSS color value, e.g. #1a1a1a. Leave: Any CSS color value, e.g. #1a1a1a. Leave empty for transparent.
Lets visitors drag the model to orbit ar: Lets visitors drag the model to orbit around it. Works independently of the click-to-toggle animation, so it's useful even for a model with no baked animation clip.
Rendered onto the model's screen\/displa: Rendered onto the model's screen/display surface (auto-detected as its most strongly emissive material) as a texture — e.g. your email and phone number. Leave empty to keep the model's original screen image. One line per line of text.
